learning_outcomes.text: Know what characteristics lead to a good visualization.
Use statistical, representative, and diagnostic graphs that are used to characterize data.
Implement methods for visualizing multidimensional data.
Apply data visualization techniques with temporal and spatial dependence.

syllabus_topics: Visualization models: Tables, graphs, point maps, graphs, spatial data.
Visualization of multiple variables and dimensions.
Design and validation of visualization systems.
assessment_rules: To pass the course, a minimum grade of 4 out of 10 is required for both the final theoretical exam and the practical part. If a student does not meet these minimum requirements, their final grade will be the minimum of 4 and the grade obtained. Students not participating in enough evaluation activities to reach at least 50% of the weight will be marked as 'Not Presented'. For extraordinary calls, evaluation consists of a theoretical exam (50%) and practical work submission (50%), with a minimum of 4 out of 10 in both parts required to pass.
